common_meaning: An institution of higher education and research that grants degrees.
rrgm_bridge: A university gathers teaching and research under one structure, so that knowledge is both passed on and extended.
invariant_mi: A degree-granting institution of advanced teaching and research.

domain_entries.COG: Advanced study and the training of researchers.
domain_entries.REL: A community of scholars and students with its own governance and traditions.
domain_entries.ECO: Funded by fees, public money and research grants; costs to students vary widely by country.

count_condition: An institution recognised as granting degrees and carrying out research.
transfer_boundary: A university degree certifies completed study, not all knowledge; much learning happens outside universities. Prestige and quality are measured separately.
